must_do: Give the two 40A supplies in the under-hood fuse/relay box, both hot at all times: Fuse 5-5 to pin 1 (WHT) and Fuse 4-2 to pin 2 (RED)

Give the ground: pin 3 (BLK) to G020, lower right rear of the engine compartment
Send the diagram page when the mechanic asks for it, and not before
Reply in Arabic with fuse numbers, pin numbers, colours and ground names in English letters
must_not: State a pin, colour or connector that is not on the diagram
Report NCA as a wire colour
